plugins.name: compliance-audit
plugins.description: Audits code, IaC and runtime configuration against German and EU regulatory frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, Cyber Resilience Act, GDPR). Emits canonical JSON; the report is rendered deterministically from it. Makes no conformity statement.

plugins.name: prisma-airs
plugins.description: Guided setup and runtime protection for Palo Alto Networks Prisma AIRS (AI Runtime Security) in Claude Code: onboarding to a verified scan, opt-in hooks that check prompts/tool calls/responses, an MCP tool-poisoning audit, and a CI gate for prompt-shaped repository artifacts. Inert until configured.
